text:
noah: noticed p95/p99 for /v1/complete diverged in the console after the routing policy change. p50 stable but tails look worse. anyone else? :thinking:
eva: I saw the spike on the EU region slice, but not US. Could be routing -> different backend pool weights?
derek: quick check: quota-engine logs show no throttles. Routing-policy-v2 shifted some traffic to small-capacity pool last night. that pool's avg latency is fine but has higher variance.
rachel: curious whether this is a real regression or an aggregation artifact. what aggregation are we showing in the dashboard?
noah: panel uses per-endpoint rollups with tdigest_merge over 1m buckets. query: 
```
SELECT quantile_from_tdigest(tdigest_merge(latency_tdigest), 0.99) AS p99 FROM endpoint_rollups WHERE endpoint='/v1/complete' AND region='eu' AND time >= now() - 2h GROUP BY time(1m)
```
eva: two possibilities: (1) routing pushed more bursty traffic to that pool causing true tail increase, or (2) tdigest_merge + larger bucket window amplifies outliers.
derek: I replayed a small trace locally: when I merge tdigest over 1m buckets vs raw samples the p99 differs by ~300ms on the same trace. raw-sample p99 unchanged.
rachel: also saw that histogram bucket config was tweaked in the infra PR (buckets ended at 600ms now). histogram interpolation fallback for sparse tdigest bins could tilt p95/p99.
console-bot: Deploy bot: routing-policy-v2 deployed 2024-11-07T03:02Z by ci/cd. :white_check_mark:
noah: ok. action items: (a) reproduce with a replay harness across pools to confirm merge artifact vs real; (b) add dashboard annotation that routing-policy-v2 rolled at X time; (c) expose percentile provenance in hover (show source: raw vs tdigest vs histogram-interp); (d) add gating note in rollout UI to ignore p99 changes within 30m of aggregation config changes.
eva: for (c) we can add a small badge: "provenance: tdigest_merge(1m)" on hover and a link to explainers.
derek: I'll open a patch to add provenance metadata to rollup documents and a test that fails if bucket boundaries change without a config-changelog entry.
rachel: short-term mitigation: pin the region routing weight back to prior pool for EU and watch. also add a manual dashboard note so oncall isn't paged for noise.
noah: thanks. if we confirm it's an aggregation artifact we'll revert the bucket tweak and update the rollout checklist.
eva: I'll add the dashboard annotation and file the UX ticket for hover provenance.
derek: PR for rollup metadata coming in a few hours, will tag you all.
rachel: leaving a reminder to add a small note in the SLO docs about how tdigest_merge semantics can change display-level percentiles.
noah: closing loop once replay + pin show stable p99. great triage everyone :thumbsup:
